node.name: Salami Cream Cheese Sandwich
node.description: This salami sandwich literally takes about 5 minutes to put together. It's the perfect lunch for work or school since you can make it the night before.
recipeIngredient: 8 oz cream cheese (cold or room temp)
1/4 cup finely chopped green onion (fresh or frozen)
1/4 cup finely chopped dill (fresh or frozen)
8 slices of sandwich bread (we used sourdough)

recipeInstructions.text: In a small bowl, combine 8 oz cream cheese, 1/4 cup green onions, 1/4 cup dill, and press in 1 garlic clove. Mash herbs into the cream cheese.
recipeInstructions.name: In a small bowl, combine 8 oz cream cheese, 1/4 cup green onions, 1/4 cup dill, and press in 1 garlic clove. Mash herbs into the cream cheese.

recipeInstructions.text: Spread about 1-2 Tbsp of the cream cheese mixture on one side of each bread slice.
recipeInstructions.name: Spread about 1-2 Tbsp of the cream cheese mixture on one side of each bread slice.

recipeInstructions.text: Top with lettuce and about 6-8 pieces of salami, or to taste.
